card.summary: H.R. 5089, the Weather Act Reauthorization Act of 2025, updates, expands, and reauthorizes various programs within the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) and related federal agencies focused on weather forecasting, research, monitoring, and data collection. The bill establishes new programs and initiatives targeting specific phenomena such as atmospheric rivers, coastal flooding, storm surges, tornadoes, hurricanes, and harmful algal blooms, while also emphasizing commercial weather data acquisition, supercomputing resources, and improved public risk communication.
